capabilities: Select UI elements in a visual pick mode
Adjust CSS override strength and force styles
Preview style changes temporarily on the document
Save modifications as a CSS snippet file
Erase or reset applied style modifications
disambiguation: Not a theme installer; it generates per-element CSS overrides saved to the vault's snippet folder.
extras: Documentation is provided in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese; saves generated styles to .snippet/--ui-designer-[vault name]-default.css.
problem: Changing Obsidian's interface styling normally requires hand-writing CSS snippets; there is no built-in way to point at a UI element and modify it visually.
summary: Visual element picker that selects Obsidian UI elements, applies CSS style overrides, and saves them as a snippet file.
